0022600130.text: The San Antonio Spurs, 0-2 at home and on a two-game losing streak, host the Sacramento Kings, who are also 0-2 and on a two-game skid, with the Spurs 5th in the Southwest and the Kings 4th in the Pacific, both 2 games back. Out for the Spurs are Jayden Quaintance (knee, surgery) and Tobias Harris (calf, strain), while the Kings are without Ben Simmons (Achilles, surgery), Dylan Cardwell (calf, strain), and Maxime Raynaud (knee, dislocated). The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Spurs won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, including a 132-104 win in Sacramento on March 17, 2026.
